answer: Oscillator-drift binding: a timing verifier fits each identity's timestamp stream against three beacons and records its drift in parts per million. Two identities whose drift series correlate above 0.95 across thirty epochs are one host, so both are voided and both $400 bonds slashed. A host with its own crystal costs $6 monthly and 20 minutes to wire, so 5,000 fakes need 5,000 machines: $30,000 monthly and $2M bonded, renewed each epoch. An honest operator runs one clock once; a farm pays in full per fake. A vault keeps one heartbeat, and no canyon of rented marble hides a shared tick.
